s: The industry-standard distributed batch engine: terabyte ETL joins, aggregations, and ML prep on clusters.
w: Driver builds a lazy DAG of transformations over RDD/DataFrame datasets; scheduler splits stages across executors holding partitions in memory where possible. Shuffle stages (wide deps) exchange data over network - THE performance driver. Catalyst optimizer plans SQL; PySpark/Scala/Java APIs. Runs on YARN/K8s/standalone.
use: Nightly terabyte-scale ETL building warehouse marts
Feature engineering pipelines training ML models
pits: Executor OOM from skewed joins - salting/broadcast-join small sides
Small-files problem after writes - compaction jobs scheduled
tips: Explain shuffle as THE cost model; skew handling stories show real experience
